risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal electronic faults.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual camera body from the front, back, and bottom.
A photo of the camera sensor with the cap removed.
A video of the camera turning on and navigating the menu.
A photo of the camera next to a handwritten note with today's date and the seller's name to verify possession.
response.reason: Only the retail box is shown in the photos. For a high-value electronic item, the actual device must be visible to confirm its existence, model, and physical condition before any valuation can be made.
